room_rent.note: Daily cash benefit paid if insured voluntarily chooses shared accommodation in a network hospital; no explicit private room entitlement stated for Standard plan — shared accommodation is the covered room type

icu.note: ICU covered as part of in-patient treatment with no stated sub-limit for Standard plan

copayment.note: No co-payment clause stated; no tier-based co-pay applies

sub_limits.display: Ambulance ₹2,000/hosp; maternity sub-limited; daily cash capped
sub_limits.note: Ambulance capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation; maternity (if opted) sub-limited; daily cash for shared room ₹500/day max ₹3,000; no disease-wise sub-limits on main in-patient cover

maternity.note: Individual: Normal ₹15,000, C-section ₹25,000 (incl. pre/post natal ₹1,500 & newborn ₹2,000); Family: Normal ₹15,000, C-section ₹25,000 (incl. pre/post natal ₹1,500 & newborn ₹2,000); waiting period 6 yrs (Individual), 4 yrs (Family); limited to 2 deliveries lifetime

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added each policy year irrespective of claims; max 100% of base SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned for Standard variant

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH treatment covered up to Sum Insured

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered when insured is recipient; donor's pre/post-hosp excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation; air ambulance not covered in Standard

modern_treatments.note: No explicit exclusion of modern/robotic treatments; covered under in-patient benefit up to SI

consumables.note: List I in Annexure I explicitly excludes gloves and many consumables

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only

notable_exclusions: Sleep apnoea, external congenital anomalies, hearing aids/spectacles, dental (unless hospitalised), infertility/IVF, self-injury, war, non-allopathic (except AYUSH)
optional_riders: Critical Illness lump sum (50% or 100% of in-patient SI, max ₹10L); Maternity benefit; Newborn baby cover
